content.text:
=== container_rebuild_required in info files that matter ===

=== Which modules list openculturas_openstreetmap in 'requires' (info.yml requires key)? ===

=== Check openculturas_map and all for a hidden 'requires' or 'optional' ===

observation.command:
cd /workspace
echo "=== container_rebuild_required in info files that matter ==="
grep -rln "container_rebuild_required" web/modules/contrib/ web/profiles/contrib/openculturas-profile/modules/custom/ 2>/dev/null | while read f; do echo "$f: $(grep container_rebuild_required $f)"; done
echo ""
echo "=== Which modules list openculturas_openstreetmap in 'requires' (info.yml requires key)? ==="
find web -name "*.info.yml" -not -path "*/vendor/*" | xargs grep -ln "requires" 2>/dev/null | head
echo ""
echo "=== Check openculturas_map and all for a hidden 'requires' or 'optional' ==="
grep -rn "openculturas_openstreetmap" web/modules/contrib/*/composer.json 2>/dev/null | head
